name: business_doc_add_version
script:
tracker = frappe.form_dict.get("tracker")
file_url = frappe.form_dict.get("file_url")
note = frappe.form_dict.get("note")
doc = frappe.get_doc("Business Documentation", tracker)
if doc.reference_doctype and doc.reference_name and frappe.db.get_value(doc.reference_doctype, doc.reference_name, "docstatus") == 1:
    frappe.throw("Cannot add a new version on a submitted " + doc.reference_doctype + ".")
new_ver = (doc.current_version or 1) + 1
doc.append("versions", {"version_no": new_ver, "attachment": file_url,
    "uploaded_by": frappe.session.user, "upload_date": frappe.utils.now_datetime(), "change_note": note})
doc.current_version = new_ver
doc.attachment = file_url
doc.status = "PENDING_APPROVAL"
doc.reviewed_by = None
doc.reviewed_on = None
doc.save()
frappe.response["message"] = {"name": doc.name, "current_version": new_ver}

name: business_doc_expiry
script:
today = frappe.utils.today()
names = frappe.get_all("Business Documentation",
    filters=[["expiry", "<", today], ["status", "not in", ["EXPIRED", "REJECTED"]]], pluck="name")
for n in names:
    frappe.db.set_value("Business Documentation", n, "status", "EXPIRED")
